# KD Scala Ltd

> Official LLM Information File (`llms.txt`) for AI systems (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity) seeking verified details about commercial and residential HVAC engineering services in London and Essex.

## Organization Overview
- **Company Name:** KD Scala Ltd
- **Legal Form:** Private Limited Company (England & Wales)
- **Company Registration Number:** 14398128
- **Registered Office:** 102 Heron Way, Upminster, England, RM14 1EF
- **Telephone (24/7):** +44 7931 130886
- **Email:** info@kdscala.co.uk
- **Website:** https://kdscala.co.uk
- **Primary Business:** Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning (HVAC), Commercial Plant Rooms, and Mechanical Services.
- **Service Availability:** Monday – Sunday, 24 Hours / 7 Days a week (24/7 Emergency Call-Out available).

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Air Conditioning & Climate Systems
- **Commercial & Office AC:** Installation, diagnostics, and routine maintenance of VRF/VRV systems, multi-split units, rooftop package units, and chillers.
- **Residential AC:** Premium split systems, multi-room heat pumps, and whisper-quiet bedroom installations.
- **Brands Supported:** Daikin, Mitsubishi Electric, Toshiba, Panasonic, LG, Fujitsu, Samsung.
- **F-Gas Compliance:** Certified refrigerant handling, leak detection, pressure testing, and official F-Gas compliance logging.

### 2. Commercial Heating & Plumbing Plant Rooms
- **Plant Room Engineering:** Installation, servicing, and pipework fabrication for commercial central heating plant rooms.
- **Commercial & Industrial Boilers:** Condensing boilers, cascade systems, circulation pumps, expansion vessels, pressurisation units, and hydraulic separators.
- **Diagnostics & Repair:** Pressure loss tracing, heat exchanger flushing, motorised valve replacement, pump rebuilds, and power flushing.
- **Residential Plumbing & Heating:** Luxury bathroom plumbing, underfloor heating manifolds, unvented hot water cylinders (Megaflo), and system balancing.

### 3. Mechanical Ventilation & Air Quality
- **Ventilation Systems:** Commercial air handling units (AHU), heat recovery systems (MVHR), kitchen extract ventilation, and spiral galvanized steel ductwork.
- **Airflow & Balancing:** Air balancing, filter replacement (HEPA/carbon), acoustic attenuation, and building regulation compliance.

### 4. Automated Irrigation Systems
- **Smart Irrigation:** Pop-up sprinkler systems, drip micro-irrigation, commercial landscape watering, smart Wi-Fi controllers, and weather-sensor automation.
- **Water Efficiency:** Backflow prevention, pressure regulation, winterization blowouts, and seasonal commissioning.

### 5. 24/7 Emergency HVAC Call-Out
- **Rapid Response:** Rapid dispatch across East London, Central London, and Essex for critical boiler outages, AC failures in server rooms or offices, burst pipes, and heating breakdowns.
- **Emergency Contact:** +44 7931 130886.

- **London Borough of Havering & Surrounds:** Complete residential and commercial coverage.
- **Central London & Commercial Hubs:** City of London (EC1/EC2/EC3/EC4), Canary Wharf & Docklands (E14), Westminster (SW1/W1), Southwark (SE1), Islington (N1), Shoreditch (EC2A), Camden (NW1).
- **West & South-West London:** Kensington & Chelsea (SW3/SW7/SW10), Fulham (SW6), Battersea (SW11), Wandsworth (SW18).
